title: Tuesday Plans
style: 95 BPM acoustic pop, NZ AU vocal lean, strummed acoustic guitars, foot stomps, big handclaps, group vocal hooks, communal call-and-response, warm upright bass, light tambourine, sunny major key, sing-along chorus, festival-ready, joyful and inclusive, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — acoustic strum, foot stomp, group "hey"]
Hey! — hey hey hey!
See you on Tuesday
Hey! — hey hey hey!
We got Tuesday plans

[Verse 1]
Monday's a maybe, Wednesday's a guess
But Tuesday's a promise, Tuesday's a yes
Met you on the corner, said "hi, I'm Corey"
Now there's a new chapter, that's the whole story

Coffee or a long walk, park bench or pier
Doesn't really matter, long as you're here
Bring a book, bring a smile, bring a half-formed plan
We'll figure out the rest — hand to hand

[Pre-Chorus]
Clap once if you're coming
Clap twice if you're sure
Three times if you'll bring a friend along
The door's open — the welcome's pure

[Chorus]
Tuesday plans, Tuesday plans
Meet me where the easy lands
Group of strangers, group of friends
Doesn't matter where it ends
Tuesday plans, Tuesday plans
Lay your simple in my hands
No big speech, no grand demand
Just Tuesday plans — simple lands

[Verse 2]
Pete's on the helm, Brandon's tuned tight
La Banda's rolling in by the late afternoon light
Rafa on the bongo, Donatello purple
Pickleball later if the weather stays gentle

Tú ya sabes — you already know
The best plans are the ones that flow
No schedule, no spreadsheet, no big agenda
Just a Tuesday — and a wide open window

[Pre-Chorus]
Clap once if you're coming
Clap twice if you're sure
Three times if you'll bring a friend along
The door's open — the welcome's pure

[Chorus]
Tuesday plans, Tuesday plans
Meet me where the easy lands
Group of strangers, group of friends
Doesn't matter where it ends
Tuesday plans, Tuesday plans
Lay your simple in my hands
No big speech, no grand demand
Just Tuesday plans — simple lands

[Bridge — group call, handclaps]
(Tuesday!) hey hey hey
(Tuesday!) hey hey hey
The hard part's done
The rest is easy
Tú ya sabes
See you on Tuesday

[Final Chorus — big group sing-along]
Tuesday plans, Tuesday plans
Meet me where the easy lands
Group of strangers, group of friends
Doesn't matter where it ends
Tuesday plans, Tuesday plans
Lay your simple in my hands
No big speech, no grand demand
Just Tuesday plans — simple lands

[Outro]
Hey — hey hey hey
See you on Tuesday
Hey — hey hey hey
Bring a book, bring a friend
The easy lands — see you then
